subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should the remaining Control UI reconnect active-run preservation be handled by reviving the open recovery PR, by a new current-main replacement, or by declaring the existing Stop/send mitigations sufficient?
rationale: The code evidence shows partial mitigations on main, while the only direct recovery PR is conflicting and proof-gated; choosing the durable active-run recovery contract is a maintainer product/ownership decision.

options.title: Open a current-main replacement
options.body: Implement the active-run recovery contract against the current ui/src/pages/chat and packages/gateway-protocol surfaces, preserving attribution to the open recovery PR where useful.

options.title: Revive the open recovery PR
options.body: Ask the contributor or an adopter to rebase it, move protocol changes to the current package, fix review findings, and add live reconnect proof.

options.title: Accept the partial mitigations
options.body: Explicitly narrow the issue to the already-merged Stop/send fixes and close only if maintainers decide active-run adoption after reconnect is not required.

recommendation.title: Open a current-main replacement
recommendation.body: Implement the active-run recovery contract against the current ui/src/pages/chat and packages/gateway-protocol surfaces, preserving attribution to the open recovery PR where useful.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the merged current-main reconnect mitigations closest to the remaining Control UI/WebChat behavior.
